projects.title: Malicious URL Classifier
projects.description:
• Created a robust neural network model with TensorFlow and Keras capable of being used as a middle layer of security before a URL is shared to identify whether it is safe or malicious. 
• Increased prediction accuracy with scraped dynamic features and a scoring function to quantify qualitative features. This identified more characteristics about the URL than simple lexicographic characteristics.

projects.title: Gaze Tracker For Sleep Detection
projects.description: • Created a gaze tracking software for drowsiness/sleep detection to prevent vehicular accidents by utilizing the Viola-Jones algorithm with Haar cascading.
